study: Fresh three-observation PCD representation for six cross-domain settings
problem: The current mean PCD discards state-specific features. Historical state recovery has a nonzero mean mismatch and cannot simply replace current inputs under old heads.
hypothesis: Retaining each of the identical three source observations permits a fair future test of state-conditioned learning versus equally informed ordinary KD.
intervention: Fresh frozen source student, same query/candidate batch8 and original context; retain per-observation FP16-roundtrip PCD and its mean.
controls: For any later comparison every ordinary/proposed learner uses the same fresh states/means and is refit; previous I1 outputs remain unchanged.
measurements: Actual student loading, inference/IO and save wall phases; exact/error comparisons with previous A100 means, without choosing a numerical acceptance threshold from target labels.
prefix_rule: Feature preparation is shared/offline; every subsequent adaptation head may read only current/past videos.
costs: Shared neural input preparation; cannot be charged as a single-method cold deployment result or counted as an innovation gain.
